text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Iraqi official press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Iraq and U.N. Special Commission start talks in Baghdad.
- Moroccan government donates medicine and foodstuffs to people of Iraq.
- U.S. to sell weapons to Saudi Arabia worth $1.1 billion.
(The above were also carried by QADISSIYA and IRAQ)
- Syrian firms to hold medical goods exhibition in Baghdad sponsored by Iraqi Health Ministry.
